tasks.short: Attend professional events and serve on committees

steps.what: Attend meetings, educational conferences and training workshops, and serve on committees

tasks.design: Retain attendance, learning and committee participation. Existing agendas in the {DOCS} can support preparation as today; a summary cannot perform the counsellor's participation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Professional learning and deliberation require attention and personal contribution.
tasks.enabler_now: No technical change is proposed to replace this attendance boundary.
tasks.still_hard: Evaluating what applies to practice and contributing to collective decisions.
tasks.human_edge: The counsellor asks questions and brings direct experience to colleagues.
tasks.altitude: Attendance requirements and committee responsibilities remain unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss how a workshop insight applies to student support

evidence.claim: Attendance, learning and committee participation remain personal work; no saving is inferred from generating meeting summaries.

assumptions: Boundary is participation, not separate event registration, minute writing or travel administration.
Organiser supplies programme and agenda through the normal process; counsellor supplies questions and contributions directly. No structured input is required for a machine step.
Existing native document access stays sufficient; no new capture or upkeep is introduced, so incremental work is zero.
research_questions: Which event insights lead to a useful change in actual counselling practice?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and incremental=0. Training participation and committee deliberation retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Teach classes and present self-help or information sessions on education and career planning

tasks.design: Keep class delivery and group discussion with the counsellor. Existing checked materials in the {DOCS} support explanations; this boundary does not invent a separate drafting workload.
tasks.previous_blocker: Teaching requires responsive explanation and attention to participants.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital materials can support delivery without removing contact time.
tasks.still_hard: Making guidance understandable for different backgrounds and expectations.
tasks.human_edge: The counsellor notices confusion, invites questions and explains uncertainty.
tasks.altitude: Teaching responsibilities and contact time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Suggest an accessible way to explain support options to a group

evidence.claim: Live teaching and information-session delivery remain human work; no material-writing baseline is assumed for this delivery task.

assumptions: Boundary is class and session delivery, not separately assigned course development or material preparation.
Counsellor supplies aims and checked information; participants supply questions directly. No structured learning profile is assumed.
Native presentation access remains as today. No new capture, build or ongoing upkeep is proposed, so incremental work is zero.
research_questions: Which explanations need more live examples or participant discussion?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=100 with incremental=0. Presentations and interactive teaching retain all contact time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Plan orientation aims and group conference activities for new life experiences
Assemble the orientation programme from chosen activities and approved service information
Conduct orientation programs and group conferences supporting adjustment to new experiences

tasks.design: Reuse approved orientation modules and service facts through a template in the {DOCS}. The counsellor chooses activities, enters the context and checks the assembled programme before leading it; substantive planning and group contact remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated programme formatting and copying current contacts can consume a small preparation slice.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable document sections can assemble chosen content without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing activities that address actual transition concerns and adjusting the group discussion.
tasks.human_edge: The counsellor recognises uncertainty and helps participants connect with appropriate support.
tasks.altitude: A small reduction in repeated programme assembly; planning authority and contact time stay unchanged.

reach.task: Check a chosen service contact in the orientation pack
reach.learn: Service scope and current contact verification

evidence.claim: Reusable approved document sections may reduce clerical programme assembly; the saving is an unmeasured E1 scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is orientation planning, programme assembly and delivery, not new admissions decisions or automatic learner classification.
Counsellor s1 produces audience, transition context, aims, session duration, access constraints and selected activity IDs. All selection and capture retain 20 hours.

Counsellor s2 enters those fields, selects approved modules and checks current contact/version details within 14 retained hours. Template insertion copies exact chosen sections and does not choose pedagogical content.
Existing programme owner supplies approved modules and ordinary current service information. New template/link upkeep is counted as focal incremental work, with no extra owner effort assumed.
Test native reusable sections before code. Missing modules or stale facts require manual preparation. s3 retains final suitability checking and full live delivery.
research_questions: Does module assembly save time after selection, source checks and final suitability review?

already_counted.description: Enter brief fields, select modules and check copied information
Final suitability check and live orientation delivery

incremental.description: Maintain approved module links and template fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact programme version, selected modules, service contacts, audience and intended activities checked before delivery; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=20+14+60=94. Gross 6 less 1 upkeep gives net 5. Low assumes unique programmes or templates already used; high requires a 20-hour repeated assembly slice. Planning and live delivery keep their time.

tasks.short: Explain available counselling services to groups and staff

steps.what: Address community groups, faculty and staff members to explain available counseling services

tasks.design: Keep service explanation and audience questions with the counsellor. Existing approved service descriptions in the {DOCS} support the presentation without replacing the conversation or inventing a slide-writing task.
tasks.previous_blocker: People need a clear explanation of service scope and how to seek help.
tasks.enabler_now: No technical change is proposed to this presentation boundary.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining limits and access routes without promising unavailable support.
tasks.human_edge: The counsellor responds to concerns and checks understanding.
tasks.altitude: Presentation time and service-explanation responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify how a person can contact an existing counselling service

evidence.claim: Service presentations and questions remain direct human communication; no labour reduction is inferred from drafting tools.

assumptions: Boundary is addressing the audience, not separate service-directory upkeep, material production or scheduling.
Service owner provides approved descriptions as today; audience produces questions directly. No structured question classifier is assumed.
Native document access remains sufficient. No new capture or upkeep is introduced, so incremental work is zero.
If the same presentation is also counted as an information session, the roll-up must assign its contact hours once.
unknowns: Audience concerns and current service capacity
research_questions: Which access routes or service limits do audiences find unclear?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and incremental=0. Explanation and audience questions retain all contact time.
